fields.statement: At 584cd6c3 built rhiza into $TMPDIR and ran it in a scratch repo (one accepted milestone change set with a leaf, Rex faked to log only, no test env vars). daemon --once --min-free 100G with the real statfs (57.8 GiB free): no Started, no rex call; daemon status shows 'Skipped: <cs> Built: disk space is low (57.8 GiB free, under the minimum of 100.0 GiB)' and --json reason disk-low. --min-free 1G: 'Started a run of <cs>', rex window new logged. --min-free -1, 10x, 1PB are usage errors (exit 2). The daemon-picks, inbox-disk-low and describe-golden scripts pass. Found two problems: RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES works without RHIZA_TEST_NOW, and the disk-low Rex notice comes one poll late

At 584cd6c3, in the same scratch repo with the built binary: after a real low-disk poll (--min-free 100G), rhiza inbox lists one '<id> disk-low' item reading '57.8 GiB free, under the minimum of 100.0 GiB: the daemon holds new starts and resumes'. The ID stays the same across a second low poll. After a poll with --min-free 1G it prints 'Nothing waits on you'. The inbox app view was checked only through go test ./internal/tui/inboxapp (PASS), not by hand
